8023.title: Pi child operations lose delegation identity
8023.rootCauseOneLine: Pi classifies child-launch tools as generic tools and has no asynchronous child-completion correlation.

prReviews.topFinding: Static mechanism matches the gap, but its extension notification assumptions were not executed or independently confirmed.

8023.proposedFix: Record and validate the real extension child lifecycle, then translate stable child identities and late terminal notifications into existing delegation deltas.
8023.caveats: Two clean runs reproduce the translator/assembler gap only; macOS desktop, real parallel extension execution, and late completion remain unverified. No safe automatic PR.
